description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Dynamic Modeling of a 10-Story Mass Timber Building Under Earthquake Excitation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joel Conte, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This project is about finite element modeling of a simplified dynamic model using commercially available software (SAP2000) to accurately predict the seismic performance of a 10-story CLT rocking wall building. This modeling structure can be reused for future research on modeling techniques to create accuracy in this technique. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gnkb-h823. Keywords: NHERI TallWood, mass timber, LHPOST, SAP2000, cross-laminated timber, finite element modeling. Published 2022-08-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
